text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The threat of the URA Finale's
cancellation has
the campus in an
uproar.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What? The URA Finale might be called
off?! No
way!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta be kidding me... And I
spent so long
planning how I was gonna
show Scarlet up...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?! Urgh, a race would've been the perfect way to settle this!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: NOOOO! The shock! The horror! All that training... wasted!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... It's a shame. I wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And the food stalls... I was looking
forward to
those the most!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There seems to be widespread
dissatisfaction
among the students
regarding the cancellation of
the URA
Finale.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text:
You're a trainer, right?! Is it true that the
URA
Finale has been canceled? There
were so many
racers I wanted to
support...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see. So the academy can't find any
replacement
turf...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Rough turf would put the runners at risk,
after
all... Still, it's unfortunate.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I heard about the URA Finale being
canceled.
What a shame...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek and I finally resolved to seize
victory there
together, too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fans who are looking forward to the
URA Finale...
Trainers and Umamusume
who see it as their
goal...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What once started out as a mere
declaration from
the director has clearly
grown into something
much bigger. Its
influence can still be felt, even in
this
dark hour.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The cancellation isn't set in stone yet, is
it?
There's just an issue with the turf.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I won't give up until the
end.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Right! Let's put our heads together!
choice_data_list: I'll think about what I can do to help too!
I'll think about what I can do to help too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We rack our brains for a way to save the
URA
Finale.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hrrragh!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Is that... the director? Where's she
running off to
at a time like this?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: R-right!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Heave... ho!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... How much of the track will this
cover?
Twenty percent? Ten? Five?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what am I doing? How can I possibly
grow all
this turf myself?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Hic...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Enough! I can't think like that! Back to
work!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Heave... ho! Grow, my beautiful turf!
Grow so that
my beloved Umamusume
can run—run towards
their dreams!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's trying to grow the turf
for the
track herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a farm the size of the one Director
Akikawa
purchased, it might actually be
possible to grow
the turf we need.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Right. There's no way the director can
produce
all that turf alone.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But if she wasn't alone, then maybe...
Just
maybe...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If two hands won't cut it, how about
four? And if
we ask more and more
people for help...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's get to it,
Trainer
<username>!
choice_data_list: Then what we have to do is decided!
Now we know what we need to do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Exhaustion... Tiredness... Fatigue... But
there's no
use feeling sorry for myself!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What's going on?! Where did this
crowd
come from?!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text:
Director! You're trying to grow turf for
the URA
Finale, right? I heard all about
it!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text:
Let us help you out! I'm looking forward
to this
event too much to miss it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We also solicited volunteers on Twinkle
Monthly's
official website.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: We'll have more hands on deck shortly.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: You all came to help? But... why?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Director! Look over there. There's more!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: More?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah, I thought an honor student like you wouldn't want to get her hands dirty.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, think again! I'll do any job
perfectly, no
matter what!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You go, King! You're doing a first-rate
job! Say,
it'd be even more first-rate if
you'd carry this soil!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's your job! Will you please take this seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You are quite the expert at handling
earth, Miss
Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What kind of weird compliment is that?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Although, hold on... a Farmer Umadol?
Maybe
that's a niche in the market!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The students too?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The URA Finale is no longer your dream
alone,
Director. The entire student body
shares your
vision.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So when a certain pair reached out to
me for
help... Why, it was simply my
duty as student
council president to
gather all the hands I could.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So when a certain pair reached out to
me for
help... Why, it was simply my
duty as student
council president to
gather all the hands I could.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: A certain pair?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: A certain pair?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We saw that you might need help
growing the
turf, so we decided to ask
for volunteers.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And when we put out the request...
Well, as you
can see, a lot of people
wanted to pitch in!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>
and
Trainer Kiryuin?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Sniff...
choice_data_list: Everyone is waiting for the URA Finals.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With this much help, we can grow plenty
of turf...
More than enough for the URA
Finale!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Thank you! And once again,
thank
you! I appreciate all of your help!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indubitably! Now, everyone... let's get to
work!
choice_data_list: Let's make the 'URA Finals' a success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're all looking forward to the URA
Finale, of
course, but I don't think that's
why so many
people have come to help
out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's really Director Akikawa's dedication
that
brought us all together... or so I
muse as I pitch in
planting turf.
